name: Poster
pitch: For a loud, fast, opinionated talk in the Takahashi style, where every slide is a gig poster and the words do all the work.

illustration.medium: flat vector, bold concert-poster silkscreen illustration
illustration.line: 5 to 6px thick strokes, high contrast, screen-print registration
illustration.shapes: big blocky letterforms and simple bold shapes (bursts, circles, banners), tight cropping
illustration.texture: slight screen-print grain, hard color edges with no anti-aliasing feel
illustration.palette_use: loud yellow background dominant, black ink, one red used for emphasis and callouts
illustration.avoid: gradients, pastel color, soft edges, photorealism, delicate line work
